mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verifications (id, email, password_hash, display_name, verification_code, expires_at, attempt_count) VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{verificationCode}, #{expiresAt}, #{attemptCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verifications SET id = #{id}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, display_name = #{displayName}, verification_code = #{verificationCode}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount} WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password_hash, display_name, verification_code, expires_at, attempt_count FROM email_verifications WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_verifications WHERE email = #{email}
